period_note: Balance sheet is the 30-Sep-2025 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (9-month). Source PDF is a scanned image (pdftotext extracted 0 lines); OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract), very clean. Cross-checked against this filing's own 31-Dec-2024 comparative column for total_assets (338,119.313571m, matches 2024_Q4.json exactly). NOTE: this filing's OWN comparative column for total_liabilities (314,569.066826m) and total_equity (23,550.246746m) already reflects the 'Start-up Equity Investment Fund' reclassification (96.068250m moved from Other Liabilities into a new equity line) that the FY2025 Annual Report later applied retroactively to its own FY2024 comparative (see 2025_Q4.json period_note) - this SOLO Q3 filing shows the very same 'Start-up Equity Investment Fund' line (107.114059m at 30-Sep-2025, 96.068250m comparative) already present, confirming the reclassification was introduced in reporting practice before FY2025 year-end, not invented at the audit. Original FY2024 totals as filed in 2024_Q4.json (314,665.135076m liabilities / 23,454.178496m equity) are unaffected and unchanged - this is a pure L-to-E reclass, assets untouched. Balance-sheet identity holds exactly for the current period (328,120.629476 + 24,646.522337 = 352,767.151813). nav_per_share (23.12) is directly legible and independently verified (24,646.522337m / 1,065.821887m shares = 23.12). Income statement fully reconciles: operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (9,626.11348-5,305.152973=4,320.960507 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (4,320.960507-2,498.495931=1,822.464576 exact); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (1,822.464576-717.883711=1,104.580865 exact). CRITICAL INSIGHT-RELEVANT FINDING: cumulative 9-month profit-before-tax is a healthy POSITIVE 1,822.464576m, with only a modest net tax EXPENSE (717.883711m, of which just 286.063414m is deferred tax); the bank's own audited FY2025 annual result (2025_Q4.json) was a full-year PRE-TAX LOSS of 1,827.040478m rescued by a 2,600.19m deferred-tax credit. This implies Q4-2025-ALONE (Oct-Dec, by subtraction) swung to a pre-tax loss of approximately 3,649.5m (-1,827.040478 - 1,822.464576) and booked a deferred-tax credit of approximately 2,886.2m in that quarter alone (-2,600.19 - 286.063414) - i.e. effectively the ENTIRE year's deferred-tax rescue and the entire pre-tax collapse both happened in the unaudited-interim-invisible fourth quarter. See insights.json for the full quantified narrative.
